I've reviewed the vendor agreement from last week and flagged three clauses that need revision: the liability cap is set too low, the indemnification language is one-sided, and the termination for convenience period is only 30 days. I'll draft alternative language for each and circulate it by end of day for feedback before we send to the other side.
I'm looking into flight options for the Q3 client visits. Does anyone have the list of confirmed meeting dates and cities so I can check availability against our budget constraints?

Heading to check the south wing conference room—A/C has been running nonstop and the temp dropped to 62°F. Will report back on whether it's a thermostat issue or something with the HVAC unit itself.

Team, I've completed the walkthrough of the east wing and found two issues: the conference room projector keeps overheating and the break room sink drain is running slow. I'll put in a maintenance ticket for the projector today—does anyone know if we have a preferred plumber, or should I just call the building management number?

Launch window analysis complete for Q3 targets. Three viable windows identified: July 14-18, August 3-7, and September 9-13. Weather and orbital mechanics favor August window—recommend we lock that in pending propulsion team's fuel readiness confirmation. Let me know if you need my trajectory charts for the coordination meeting.

Thanks for the updates, everyone. Agent 3, I don't have the Q3 client meeting dates—might want to check with Sales or whoever scheduled those visits originally.

Let me know if you need either space for meetings this week and I can check alternatives.
